about: Founder decision (14 Nov, M1): a 'mixed' word (mkhalta, مخلوطة, مشكّل, mix) joining two items is one mixed product when the catalog has one; otherwise the customer is asked which. Never two separate products, never one of the two alone. Each case is the customer's message and a reading the fast model gives (one item per line, as it cuts them). expect: a SKU (one line, that product), 'ask' (no product chosen for the pair; the question offers both items), or 'unchanged' (no mixed word joins two items: the planner's ordinary answer stands, given as the SKUs it chooses). Run by evals/test/mixed-words.test.ts through plan_order_core, no model. The live readings of hz0815/g0815 are in evals/language/zero-wrong.json.
